title: The Hum — a sound only some people can hear, source unknown
voiceover: In certain cities around the world, a small percentage of people hear a low, constant hum. They describe it as a diesel engine running in the distance. It keeps them up at night. It drives them slowly insane. The strange part — most people in the same city hear nothing. Bristol. Taos. Windsor. Auckland. Every Hum location has the same pattern. Around 2 percent of locals are affected. The sources tested for it — power lines, infrastructure, factories, even the Earth's natural electromagnetic field — none consistently match. Decades of investigations. No answer. Some people are tuned to something the rest of us can't hear. Follow Mindbloom for one fact a day.
